syllabus_topics: Markets, efficiency, and the role of the State
GDP and economic growth, innovation and technological progress
Banks, money, and credit market; financial crises and globalization
Digital economy, information, and social challenges
assessment_rules: The final grade in the normal period is 50% from the exam and 50% from continuous assessment. A minimum grade of 8 values is required on the exam. For the resit period, if a student was absent from the normal period exam, the continuous assessment grade still counts for 50%. If a student attended the normal period, did not complete projects, or if the final grade decreases with projects considered, the resit exam counts for 100% of the grade, with a minimum of 8 values. The special period exam counts for 100%.
bibliography: Jean Tirole, Economia do Bem Comum, Guerra e Paz, 2018 (main)

John Komlos, Foundations of Real-World Economics, Routledge, Taylor and Francis Group, 3rd edition, 2023 (main)
